ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites: CEE 462 and CEE 470. Geometric and material nonlinearities in steel frames; frame element formulation including geometric stiffness and concentrated plasticity; effects of imperfections on frame behavior and modeling approaches for accurate nonlinear assessment; nonlinear solution strategies for frame analysis; elastic and inelastic frame stability; assessment and design of frame structures using nonlinear analysis.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Civil Engr - Online - UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MS: Aerospace Engr-Online-UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC.
